Class_Skill_Desc_Dark Cannon: Deals unaspected damage with a potency of 210 to target and all enemies nearby it.</br>Potency scales with item level.</br>Additional Effect: Blind</br>Duration: 30s</br>Shares a recast timer with Shock Cannon.
Class_Skill_Desc_Holy Cannon: Deals unaspected damage with a potency of 210 to target and all enemies nearby it.</br>Potency increases to 500 when used against undead enemies.</br>Potency scales with item level.</br>Shares a recast timer with Silver Cannon.
Class_Skill_Desc_Phantom Fire: Deals unaspected damage with a potency of 210 to target and all enemies nearby it.</br>Potency scales with item level.</br>Additional Effect: 5% chance to kill target instantly, with some exceptions
Class_Skill_Desc_Shock Cannon: Deals unaspected damage with a potency of 210 to target and all enemies nearby it.</br>Potency scales with item level.</br>Additional Effect: Paralysis</br>Duration: 18s</br>Shares a recast timer with Dark Cannon.
Class_Skill_Desc_Silver Cannon: Deals unaspected damage with a potency of 210 to target and all enemies nearby it.</br>Potency scales with item level.</br>Additional Effect: Afflicts target with Silver Sickness, reducing damage target deals by 10% and increasing damage taken by 5%</br>Duration: 70s</br>Effect cannot be stacked with Phantom Dancer's Mesmerized.</br>Shares a recast timer with Holy Cannon.
Class_Trait_Desc_Enhanced Phantom Fire: Grants a 5% chance to instantly kill targets when executing Phantom Fire, with some exceptions.
